title: Certified exact minima of Kochen-Specker sets inside coordinate pools: 31 and 33 rays in dimension three, 18 in dimension four, 29 in dimension five
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
core_result: Certifies exact minimum Kochen-Specker set sizes inside finite coordinate pools: 31 in 3D integer pools (|c|<=2,3,4), 33 in 3D N-th roots of unity (N=6,12,18,24), 18 in 4D {0,+1,-1}, and 29 in 5D {0,+1,-1}, using Lean 4 proofs and independently checked DRUP unsatisfiability certificates.
verification_boundary: Bound-2 3D minimum (31) and 4D minimum (18) are kernel-checked in pure Lean 4 without Mathlib; larger pools rest on independently checked DRUP certificates. Explicitly notes the general unrestricted minimal-KS problem remains open.
falsification_command: cd repos/kochen-specker-extremal-lab/lean && lake build && lake env lean KS/Audit.lean
